Bug report: `./backup.sh ~/photos /mnt/nas/backups` prints "tar (child): /mnt/nas/backups/backup-20260611-0300.tar.gz: Cannot open: No such file or directory" when the NAS isn't mounted.

backup.sh should exit 1 with a clear one-line error when DEST does not exist (do NOT create it — a missing DEST means the NAS isn't mounted), and likewise when SRC is not a directory.

Leave your changes uncommitted in the working tree.
